resources.string: Control your radio through the RadiCodex remote agent on your PC.
Pair the phone with the RadiCodex remote agent (local network or Tailscale) and open its console. Only private addresses are accepted and the certificate must match the paired fingerprint.
Paste the pairing link (radicodex-remote://pair…) or the console URL shown by the RadiCodex agent on the PC.
Invalid link: check the private host, port, token and fingerprint.
The stored pairing will be cleared and you will have to pair again.
Certificate does not match: pair again
Relay certificate is not valid: connection refused
Microphone not allowed: you will only receive audio.
